name: Corporate Action Option 15 Code
definition: Specifies the type of corporate action options.

ABST.name: Abstain
ABST.definition: Vote expressed as abstain. In this case, the issuing company will add the number of shares to the quorum of the meeting.|If the voting right is not executed, it will not be added to the quorum. In this case, code NOAC should be used.

BSPL.name: Bonus Share Plan
BSPL.definition: Receive equities from the share premium reserve of the company and considered as a capital distribution rather than a disbursement of income with different tax implications (typically found in Australia).

BUYA.name: Buy Up
BUYA.definition: Buy additional securities to round up position.

CASE.name: Cash And Security
CASE.definition: Option to choose between different security and cash options.

CEXC.name: Consent And Exchange
CEXC.definition: Vote to consent to change the terms of the securities agreement and to exchange securities.

CONN.name: Consent Denied
CONN.definition: Vote not to approve the event or proposal.

CONY.name: Consent Granted
CONY.definition: Vote to approve the event or proposal.

CTEN.name: Consent And Tender
CTEN.definition: Vote to consent to change the terms of the securities agreement and to tender securities for cash.

LAPS.name: Lapse
LAPS.definition: Allow event or entitled security to expire.

MPUT.name: Retain
MPUT.definition: Option that allows a holder to elect to retain their holding, for example, a putable bond.

NOAC.name: No Action
NOAC.definition: Option for the account owner not to take part in the event. This would include opt-out for class actions and lodging of dissenters' rights.

NOQU.name: Non Qualified Investor
NOQU.definition: Account owner is a non-qualified investor.

OFFR.name: Proposed Rate
OFFR.definition: In a remarketing of variable notes, the margin that shareholders can propose in respect of the next interest period.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Generic corporate action option to be used in case that no other specific code is appropriate.

OVER.name: Oversubscribe
OVER.definition: Subscribe to more equities than underlying securities position allows.

QINV.name: Qualified Investor
QINV.definition: Account owner is a qualified investor.

PRUN.name: Unknown Proceeds
PRUN.definition: Proceeds not known during election period. The option can result in cash and/or securities.

BOBD.name: Beneficial Owner Breakdown Request
BOBD.definition: Breakdown of beneficial ownership required for withholding tax reclaim event.
